decisive_finding: The August print faces a mechanically contaminated EPS comp that no narrative source flags. From audited XBRL: FY2025 income tax expense $93.7M against 9M FY2025 expense of $102.2M implies FQ4-FY25 (Jun-25) tax of MINUS $8.5M on $258.3M of pre-tax income — an FY effective rate of 11.6% versus a 9M rate of 18.7%. Net income ($266.8M) exceeded operating income ($261.4M) that quarter. At the ~19.4% run-rate tax, FQ4-25 EPS would have been $3.44 rather than the reported $4.41 — roughly $0.97/share, 22% of the print, was non-recurring. With no earnings call and no adjusted-EPS release, nothing flagged it, and $4.41 is the comp the market will use on ~2026-08-20. Base case FQ4-26: revenue ~$820M (+8.0% y/y), op margin ~36.5%, EPS ~$4.02 — DOWN ~9% y/y on revenue UP ~8%. Honest counter: Ubiquiti trues its annual tax up in Q4 every year (FQ4-24 rate 14.7% vs 18.6% 9M; FY22 14.8%; FY21 15.3%), so FY25's outright benefit was the extreme rather than the pattern; a repeat 10-12% Q4 rate puts FQ4-26 EPS at ~$4.45 and the headline survives.

edge_explainer: The screen scored UI 87.7 on a '-49% from own 3-year high,' but the tape shows that drawdown is mostly the round-trip of a +54% melt-up from $712 to $1,099.99 (2026-02-10 to 2026-04-21) during which EDGAR records ZERO company filings — a pure flow event in a stock with a 4.21M-share, 7% float behind a 93% founder holding. Strip that out and there is no discount: 35.2x TTM earnings and a 2.2% FCF yield sit at the high end of the 25-35x band UI occupied from 2018 through 2024. The business is genuinely excellent and genuinely intact — 46-47% gross margin and 36% operating margin in HARDWARE, $369M net cash after retiring $1.09B of debt, zero dilution, improving DSO and falling inventory into a growth acceleration, full tariff pass-through demonstrated — which is why this is a 3 and not a 1. Against that: our scenario set gives E[FV] $516 for a -6.0% edge, and the tape implies a HIGHER p_bull (0.32) than we hold (0.25). The August 20/21 print sits 17-18 days out with a year-ago EPS comp inflated ~$0.97 by a non-recurring tax benefit, in a name that gaps 20-30% on prints, with no listed options at our broker to hedge it and zero disclosure latency to pre-position on. Two microstructure findings are the durable output. First, the ABSENCE of a masking channel is itself the finding: a company that gives no guidance, holds no calls and markets nothing cannot produce takeaway-vs-data divergence, so the honesty framework has no purchase here and the correct answer is to say so rather than manufacture a flag. Second, float structure gates information transmission — a researched sanctions-evasion allegation against a $33B issuer moved it +0.16%, which means this security will not transmit a bear thesis into price and will not transmit a bull one either without a flow event. The queue's ai_complex:true tag is wrong on demand (91% of revenue is prosumer/SMB UniFi; no datacenter product; the only 'AI' in the 10-Q is two risk factors) and the real AI linkage runs backwards through single-source Qualcomm/Broadcom chipsets and contested contract-manufacturing capacity, making UI a modest AI-BREAK beneficiary at the margin line and a real diversifier against a household already 26% AI-exposed. That portfolio argument is the best case for the name, it is not a valuation argument, and it is not enough at $548.66.
